[[Bright Tree Village/Legends|Bright Tree Village's]] '''harvest store''' was where the tribe stocked food.

On one [[Halloween/Legends|Hallowe'en]], the harvest store was the site of a [[Dulok/Legends|Dulok]] raid and the accidental kidnapping of [[Chief/Legends|Chief]] [[Chirpa/Legends|Chirpa]].
